what_happened: Dispatch description mis-locates an input: it states the six-mechanism survival analysis lives in specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/one-sided-count-move-refutation.lean, but that file contains no mechanism table and the word 'six' does not appear in it. The table is the 'Mechanism-by-mechanism measurement' section of the originating probe's archived research report in the source repository. Resolved at plan time as a citation decision (cite the durable probe paths, not the renumberable archived task directory) rather than a research gap.

Caught at plan authoring time that generate-context-line-counts.sh refuses to run from the agent-system source store (explicit diagnostic, nonzero exit) and must be invoked as the DEPLOYED copy .claude/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh even though it rewrites the source index-entries.json files. A nearby precedent plan names the source-store path, which would have failed mid-phase; every invocation in this plan names the deployed entry point.

Ran suite_selection_select once as a single multi-path call over each phase's whole Files-to-modify set before writing its Tier Justification, then confirmed with validate-artifact.sh; the validator's under-verification warning named the deployed-corpus suites the source-store run omitted (test-lean-src-roots.sh, test-sapience-capture.sh), and the plan now validates with zero warnings.
